description: Get detailed catalog card by book_id. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

adult_confirmed.description: Set true ONLY if the user has confirmed they are 18 or older; otherwise description/cover of 18+ books are returned as null.

name: book_details
